description: This PHP class 'I18NMessagesController' handles requests related to internationalization (i18n) messages. It retrieves translation messages for specific locales, manages cache headers, and responds with localized content in JSON format. The class is part of the OrangeHRM system's internationalization plugin, acting as a web controller for i18n message retrieval.

classes.name: I18NMessagesController
classes.description: Controller for internationalization messages, providing localized JSON responses based on requested locale

methods.name: getI18NService
methods.description: Retrieves the I18NService instance from the dependency container

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming requests to retrieve translation messages for a specified or default locale, setting appropriate cache headers and handling conditional GET

methods.name: setCommonHeaders
methods.description: Sets common HTTP headers for cache control and content type on the response object
